set.descent_text: From the top, either build a V-thread or rappel from trees. You can also take the easy walk-off to skier's right around the end of the second tier, which leads back to the bottom.
set.approach: In winter the road beyond the last plowed stretch is a long ski or walk to the Granite Lake trailhead, and the trail then follows Granite Creek up to Granite Lake, so plan a long approach or an overnight camp at the lake. Cross the lake toward the wall, work up the left side, and traverse over at the level of the second tier. The Three Tiers sit across the gully from the Thunderdome. It is the farthest left route on the second tier.

review.notes: Route page for tier, start and descent; approach from the Granite Lake and Three Tiers area pages, with the lake and trail confirmed by the AAJ and Alpinist accounts. No distances given, as sources vary.
